text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is what happens when your
mind's not
in it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think I've had enough. I can't take any
more
humiliation.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Quit it with that gaze. You're way too
intense
sometimes, you know that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When you look so determined... how am
I
supposed to refuse?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're my trainer. Do whatever you
want.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what are you even thinking? I
just don't get it.
